glosses: used to emphasize emotion, judgment, etc.
used to indicate a common occurrence in the past (after a verb in past tense)
used to indicate a general tendency
used to indicate something that should happen

exampleTranslations.2: Robert used to help his father in the store on weekends.
exampleTranslations.3: I'd like to see your sister.
exampleTranslations.4: Wilson's solution is similar to Hudson's in that they used the same constants.
exampleTranslations.6: I used to come to this beach when I was a boy.
